title: An instruction that opened the room, before any message, opens the history of the agent's later turns, the round of its turn after it: its turn's request is extended
notes: Python: turns/_wiring.py build_tool_history_loader reads the agent's rows from the room's message before its context on, and channels/_tool_history.py with_tool_rounds places an instruction whose turn the history holds, even before its first message, and the rounds of that turn after it: a handoff's greeting that looks something up, say (RMK-1407). A call's arguments are left out of chat_messages: each implementation writes their JSON its own way, the same way from one turn to the next.
